## Recovered observations

155 points (from FA-38) read by two readings made separately and reconciled (batch `curves-appa-b2`, rules `docs/CURVE-READING.md (2026-10-08)`). Values are SI; the printed-unit values and the pixel coordinates on the page image are kept beside them so every point can be checked against the scan. x_read_bound and y_read_bound are reading bounds in printed units: the largest change of value over the point's pixel interval on the piecewise map, plus the location error of the two lines around it (D-025; the global calibration residual is not added, see qa/<batch>/calibration-sensitivity.md for the affine difference); x_bound_si and y_bound_si are the same in SI. They are not standard deviations.

Both readings drawn on the page image (filled circles: Claude's reading; hollow squares: Codex's; bars: pixel bounds; the canonical reading of each panel is named in the batch review). Click to enlarge.

## Notes from the two readings

- Claude: Inset D50 0.07 mm (0.06-0.08); D10 Small; Cu Large; D95 4.1 mm (4.0-4.2). Curves end near 50 percent at the No. 200 sieve (0.074 mm) so D50 lies at the end of the sieved range. Reprinted under soil 11 (FA-42). Table 2-3 prints D95 4.
- Codex: Seven samples; D10 Small and Cu Large; individual sample identities missing. Also specification 11. AM-68-1 Vol. II, Fig. A-38, printed A-76, PDF 77
